body.query: Who became the new CEO of Syngenta Group in August 2026?

results.title: Syngenta Group Appoints Hengde Qin as Chief Executive Officer | Syngenta Group
highlights:
- Succession from COO follows deliberate Board process, Jeff Rowe to remain CEO through August 1

Syngenta Group today announced that its Board of Directors has unanimously appointed Hengde Qin as Chief Executive Officer, effective August 1, 2026, following a thorough nomination and succession process. Qin, currently Chief Operating Officer and Head of Seeds, succeeds Jeff Rowe, who will remain in the role through August 1 before returning to the United States after nearly 10 years with the company.

# Hengde Qin’s Post
...
CEO at Syngenta Group | Global Agricultural Technology Leader | Advancing Breakthroughs for Farmers, in Every Field
...
I begin serving as CEO of Syngenta Group today. As I do, I find myself thinking not about boardrooms, but about the small farming village where I grew up. That is where I saw firsthand the resilience, determination and hard work of farming families. What I learned there continues to shape how I see the world and my belief in the importance of agriculture in strengthening food security. A growing population, climate pressures and finite natural resources mean the world must produce more food, more sustainably. Helping farmers meet that challenge is why Syngenta Group exists. I feel fortunate to lead a company with deep Swiss roots, an international outlook, world-class science, and exceptional people. Yet what makes Syngenta Group truly special is our shared purpose: breakthroughs for farmers, in every field. I will lead with humility, openness and a willingness to listen. Staying close to farmers, customers, partners and colleagues will always be important to me. Together, we can help farmers achieve higher yields with lower impact and contribute to food security. Looking ahead, our strategic direction is clear, and our commitment to farmers, innovation and our people is as strong as ever. We have solid foundations, an important mission and a tremendous opportunity to help define the future of agriculture. Agriculture has always been about generations, not quarters. The seeds we plant today will become tomorrow's harvest. That mindset will continue to guide me as we create lasting value for farmers and future generations – together.#SyngentaGroup#CEO#FoodSecurity#Breakthroughs#Leadership
